D.treatment: science-subject learning contexts

O.outcome_detail: bodily sensation activation profile

cells.quote: Humanities subjects (Chinese, English, Politics, History) were primarily associated with increased activation in the head and distal upper limbs, accompanied by deactivations in the lower limbs.
